svg.title: ARMOR-ANDROID-CONTROL architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-ANDROID-CONTROL reads and orders through ARMOR-SERVER and nothing else, except Bluetooth to set up a node, GitHub for its own updates and a public weather service. The rules are covered by 342 unit tests; the app runs on a real phone against the CM5 test bench; push through Firebase and the screens for solar, electrical and alarm-panel equipment have not met real hardware.

svg.text: The phone window on ARMOR-SERVER: alarms that follow you, cameras, radar, energy, the network and the set-up of nodes over Bluetooth.
